_comment: Cross-airport replication of the KRDU imitation result at KSJC. Everything measured in docs/2026-08-19_control_bank_wiggle_diagnosis.zh.md section 12 comes from one airport, so the claim that simple-v3 fixes the straight-track curving is currently airport-scoped. Two arms, paired on the same KSJC val flights: the simple-v2 baseline, and simple-v2 + control_imitation_loss_weight = 64.0, which reproduces simple-v3 field-for-field (asserted by test_simple_v3_is_the_settled_production_recipe and re-checked before launch). Same seed 1337 as the KRDU ladder. What replication would look like: bank skill crossing from below the random-flight floor to well above it, common-profile share falling toward the flown tracks' own value, and ADE not degrading. KSJC is the harder read of the two -- its random-flight floor is +0.312 against KRDU's +0.170, and bank carries only 18 percent of the box-normalised imitation term there against 41 percent at KRDU -- so a weaker effect here would not by itself contradict KRDU.
